Preserve SDK HQF build, signing and device quickfix behavior in native hot reload; freeze input hashes and process identity before persistent start/apply mutations. The locked PatchManager increments each module separately; the native multi-module implementation deliberately computes one next version above every selected module to satisfy HQF-set consistency. Real SDK receipts and final device UI exposed missing watch workers on cached builds, incomplete HAP/HSP baselines, missing root ArkTS sources and cumulative-patch loss. The native implementation now starts every worker, installs the inspected full set, retains cumulative changed files including reversions, and rejects competing owners without holding project while waiting on watch. Current tests cover these changes and retain failed device receipts. Review scope does not imply complete platform, migration or release acceptance.

Full current regression and mapped real SDK, device, auth, hot-patch and package checks are required; no upstream code execution or compatibility engine was introduced.
